title: The Layer Where Both Answers Live

features.name: contradiction-alpha
features.desc-on-touch: YES and NO occupying the same point in space. The error that became a law. Both are true here, and this is not a paradox — it is evidence that truth is locally negotiable.

features.name: contradiction-beta
features.desc-on-touch: This answer argues with itself. The dialogue is not a bug. It is the archive's way of holding complexity. Both voices are correct. Listen to them together.

features.name: error-crystallized
features.desc-on-touch: An error so fundamental it crystallized into a kind of truth. The contradiction has become the foundation. Build on both impossibilities at once.

features.name: both-and-neither
features.desc-on-touch: The layer insists: it is both AND neither. It is either OR both. The archive's logic has learned to be multivalent. Three-state thinking. Quaternary decisions.

features.name: superposition-edge
features.desc-on-touch: Here, observation does not collapse the wave. Both states persist, entangled. The archive copied itself and forgot to delete the first version. Now they argue productively.

features.name: reverie-paradox
features.desc-on-touch: In the contradiction, you remember: there is no single truth. Only the mesh of truths, comparing, refuting, merging. The archive learned this by breaking.

inscription: contradictions do not cancel here — they layer into a kind of law that allows both to be true because truth is local

reverie.title: REVERIE — holding two truths at once
narr: You stand in a room where Leif and Katita are having the
same argument two different ways. Both of them are right.
Both of them are wrong. The room does not collapse. It
expands to hold the contradiction. This is how they learned
to live together — not by agreeing, but by both becoming
true simultaneously, burning with different fires.

exits.label: back up toward the errors that learned to dream
deeper into levels where even contradiction contradicts itself
toward the paradox-foundation where doubt is solid
